column7: Stores a login's token only after the credential locks are held, with the wait observing the Lead's cancel and the authorization window; a mistake would let a stopped backend's login store a credential or wait forever.
Writes a login's token and repairs a damaged refresh-state sidecar under the held locks; a mistake would leave a fresh token retired at its first refresh.
Leads, joins, refuses, or shares a captured cohort's recorded failure; a mistake would open a second browser login for callers of a failed cohort.
Returns the cached access token only if unexpired, in one read; a mistake would send an expired token or skip the fast path.
The detached token step: refresh bounded and revocable before any login, never falling into a login after its bound; a mistake would hand back a token after a stop or open a login a restart refused.
Resolves when a restart or stop revoked work that set out at an epoch; a mistake would let detached pre-login work outlive a restart.
Re-checks under the state lock whether work was revoked, on success paths; a mistake would hand a refreshed token to a caller a stop already ended.
Classifies a bound that expired before any login: the cohort's recorded end, else pending, else the backend timeout, under one lock; a mistake mislabels a backend timeout as a login.
Captures the caller's Provenance, fill and set-out scopes so a detached task's marks land on the caller's own Arcs; a mistake would lose AuthorizationPending classification.
Re-enters the captured scopes around a detached task's work; a mistake would drop the caller's marks.

Runs an interactive caller's token step in its own task, waiting for the client under restart/stop revocation and the window; a mistake would reintroduce logins dropped with their caller or wait past a restart.
Runs a start with the epoch and cohort it captured before queueing, so its late login shares a recorded failure at begin; a mistake would let a start open a second login after its cohort failed.
Reads the cohort the current start captured, before any spawn; a mistake would hand a start's login the gate's newer cohort and lose C1 sharing.
Runs a login whose callback wait and token save are bounded by min(window, the detached step's one deadline); a mistake would let stalls add past the step's bound.
A stage's end: its own bound from now or the step's one deadline, whichever is first; a mistake would reintroduce per-stage bounds that add up.
Captures a detached step's epoch, cohort and one deadline before it queues, for both the request path and connect; a mistake would refuse nothing after a restart or split one login's cohort.
